The thing which gave Bunyan any notoriety in the days of his ungodliness, and which made him afterwards appear to himself such a monster of iniquity, was the energy which he put into all his doings.

47120-quarter-back-bates.title: Bates
47120-quarter-back-bates.creator: Ralph Henry Barbour
47120-quarter-back-bates.description: A book by Ralph Henry Barbour. Wally was one of those well-meaning but too talkative youths such as we have all met. But Dick played the game perfectly this morning, descending from the carriage--Mr. Bates was one of the very few persons left in Leonardville who could afford an automobile and still drove horses--with an expression of questioning surprise.

arxiv-1903-05414.title: Interkinetic nuclear migration in the zebrafish retina as a diffusive process
arxiv-1903-05414.creator: Afnan Azizi, Anne Herrmann, Yinan Wan, Salvador J. R. P. Buse, Philipp J. Keller, Raymond E. Goldstein, William A. Harris
arxiv-1903-05414.description: Abstract A major hallmark of neural development is the oscillatory movement of nuclei between the apical and basal surfaces of the neuroepithelium during the process of interkinetic nuclear migration (IKNM). Here, we employ long-term, rapid lightsheet and two-photon imaging of zebrafish retinas in vivo during early development to uncover the physical processes that govern the behavior of nuclei during IKNM.

arxiv-1910-00574.title: Driven-dissipative quantum Kerr resonators: new exact solutions, photon blockade and quantum bistability
arxiv-1910-00574.creator: David Roberts, Aashish A. Clerk
arxiv-1910-00574.description: Abstract We present a new approach for deriving exact, closed-form solutions for the steady state of a wide class of driven-dissipative nonlinear resonator that is distinct from more common complex- P P function methods. Our method generalizes the coherent quantum absorber approach of Stannigel et al. Stannigel et al.

arxiv-2003-14386.title: Evaluating Amharic Machine Translation
arxiv-2003-14386.creator: Asmelash Teka Hadgu, Adam Beaudoin, Abel Aregawi
arxiv-2003-14386.description: Abstract Machine translation (MT) systems are now able to provide very accurate results for high resource language pairs. However, for many low resource languages, MT is still under active research. In this paper, we develop and share a dataset 1 1 1 https://zenodo.org/record/3734260 to automatically evaluate the quality of MT systems for Amharic.

arxiv-2009-02053.title: Asymmetric Information Acquisition Games
arxiv-2009-02053.creator: Vartika Singh, Veeraruna Kavitha
arxiv-2009-02053.description: Abstract We consider a stochastic game with partial, asymmetric and non-classical information, where the agents are trying to acquire as many available opportunities/locks as possible. Agents have access only to local information, the information updates are asynchronous and our aim is to obtain relevant equilibrium policies.

arxiv-2112-07864.title: 4 α \alpha linear-chain state produced by 9 Be+ 9 Be collision
arxiv-2112-07864.creator: Tomoyuki Baba 1 , Yasutaka Taniguchi 2,6 Masaaki Kimura 3,4,5,6
arxiv-2112-07864.description: Abstract Extreme nuclear deformations provide great insight into the geometric formation of quantum many-body systems. In this work, the 4 ​ α + 2 ​ n 4\alpha+2n linear chain is assessed in 18 O. We predict excitation energies, moment-of-inertia, α \alpha -, and 9 Be-decay widths by using the antisymmetrized molecular dynamics.

arxiv-2206-04029.title: Accelerating Score-based Generative Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
arxiv-2206-04029.creator: Hengyuan Ma, Li Zhang, Xiatian Zhu, Jingfeng Zhang, Jianfeng Feng
arxiv-2206-04029.description: Abstract Score-based generative models (SGMs) have recently emerged as a promising class of generative models. The key idea is to produce high-quality images by recurrently adding Gaussian noises and gradients to a Gaussian sample until converging to the target distribution, a.k.a. the diffusion sampling.

arxiv-2401-01809.title: Evidential strength of categorical expert witness statements
arxiv-2401-01809.creator: R.J.F.Ypma
arxiv-2401-01809.description: Abstract In many jurisdictions, forensic evidence is presented in the form of categorical statements by forensic experts. In recent years, the scientific validity of forensic science practices have been questioned. In response, several large-scale performance studies have been performed, reporting various error rates for different forensic fields. This important work has elucidated the uncertainty associated with categorical statements.

arxiv-2407-05245.title: Electrical magnetochiral anisotropy and quantum metric in chiral conductors
arxiv-2407-05245.creator: Yiyang Jiang, Qinyan Yi, Binghai Yan
arxiv-2407-05245.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yiyang Jiang, Qinyan Yi, Binghai Yan. Electrical magnetochiral anisotropy (EMCA) refers to the chirality- and current-dependent nonlinear magnetoresistance in chiral conductors and is commonly interpreted in a semiclassical picture. In this work, we reveal a quantum geometry origin of EMCA using a chiral rectangular lattice model that resembles a chiral organic conductor (DM-EDT-TTF) 2 ClO 4 studied for EMCA recently and exhibits symmetry-protected Dirac bands similar to those of graphene.

arxiv-2504-13341.title: The Use of Wigner Expansion and Path Integral Method for Quantum Correction of the Low-Order Spectral Moments and Collision-Induced Absorption Profiles
arxiv-2504-13341.creator: Daniil N. Chistikov, Artem A. Finenko
arxiv-2504-13341.description: Abstract This study aims at examination of the lower-order spectral moments in collision-induced absorption (CIA), taking the translational He-Ar band as an example. General quantum corrections for the zeroth and first spectral moments are derived on the basis of the Wigner expansion up to the order of ℏ 8 \hbar^{8} and ℏ 10 \hbar^{10} , respectively.

arxiv-2505-16761.title: Mesh-RFT: Enhancing Mesh Generation via Fine-Grained Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
arxiv-2505-16761.creator: Jian Liu Jing Xu Song Guo Jing Li Jingfeng Guo Jiaao Yu, Haohan Weng Biwen Lei Xianghui Yang Zhuo Chen Fangqi Zhu, Tao Han Chunchao Guo
arxiv-2505-16761.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jian Liu Jing Xu Song Guo Jing Li Jingfeng Guo Jiaao Yu, Haohan Weng Biwen Lei Xianghui Yang Zhuo Chen Fangqi Zhu, Tao Han Chunchao Guo. Existing pretrained models for 3D mesh generation often suffer from data biases and produce low-quality results, while global reinforcement learning (RL) methods rely on object-level rewards that struggle to capture local structure details.

arxiv-2508-11985.title: Efficient Modular Learning through Naive LoRA Summation: Leveraging Orthogonality in High-Dimensional Models
arxiv-2508-11985.creator: Zhanhao Cao, Clement Truong, Andrew Lizarraga
arxiv-2508-11985.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) are heavily supported by the size of their parameters, often reaching into the trillions. In parallel, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) [ 1 , 2 ] has emerged, allowing models to be fine-tuned by updating only a small fraction of parameters.

arxiv-2508-21670.title: Anomalous ultrafast heat transfer in single palladium nanocrystals seen with an X-ray free electron laser
arxiv-2508-21670.creator: David Yang, James Wrigley, Jack Griffiths, Longlong Wu, Ana F. Suzana, Jiecheng Diao, Angel Rodriguez-Fernandez, Joerg Hallmann, Alexey Zozulya, Ulrike Boesenberg, Roman Shayduk, Jan-Etienne Pudell, Anders Madsen, Ian K. Robinson
arxiv-2508-21670.description: Abstract We report transient highly strained structural states in individual palladium (Pd) nanocrystals, electronically heated using an optical laser, which precede their uniform thermal expansion. Using an X-ray free-electron laser probe, the evolution of individual 111 111 Bragg peaks is measured as a function of delay time at various laser fluences.

arxiv-2510-01785.title: cuHPX: GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Spherical Harmonic Transforms on HEALPix Grids
arxiv-2510-01785.creator: Xiaopo Cheng, Akshay Subramaniam*, Shixun Wu, Noah Brenowitz
arxiv-2510-01785.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiaopo Cheng, Akshay Subramaniam*, Shixun Wu, Noah Brenowitz. HEALPix (Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelization) is a widely adopted spherical grid system in astrophysics, cosmology, and Earth sciences. Its equal-area, iso-latitude structure makes it particularly well-suited for large-scale data analysis on the sphere. However, implementing high-performance spherical harmonic transforms (SHTs) on HEALPix grids remains challenging due to irregular pixel geometry, latitude-dependent alignments, and the demands for high-resolution transforms at scale.

arxiv-2605-26945.title: A tridiagonal matrix-valued process with stochastic resetting for arbitrary Dyson index β > 0 \beta>0
arxiv-2605-26945.creator: Gernot Akemann, Satya N. Majumdar and Patricia Päßler

britannica-1911-schack-adolf-friedrich-g.title: Schack, Adolf Friedrich, Graf von (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-schack-adolf-friedrich-g.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-schack-adolf-friedrich-g.description: Article 'Schack, Adolf Friedrich, Graf von' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 24), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of the grand duke of Oldenburg, whom he accompanied on a journey to the East. On his return he entered the Oldenburg government service, and in 1849 was sent as envoy to Berlin. In 1852 he retired from his diplomatic post, resided for a while on his estates in Mecklenburg and then travelled in Spain, where he studied Moorish history.

doe-osti-3943090-facilitating-the-use-of.title: Facilitating the use of Common Test Definitions by Converting Test Sequences to IEEE Standards using Large Language Models
doe-osti-3943090-facilitating-the-use-of.creator: Wilke, Rudeger H.T., Smith, Jonathan Robert
doe-osti-3943090-facilitating-the-use-of.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. [TE2.1][TE2.2]This report describes the progress of a prototype GUI, nicknamed LightStar, that enables engineers to convert existing test scripts into IEEE-compliant, XML-based documents, as well use these documents to automatically generate executable scripts.

pmc-10560666.title: Four new triterpene saponins from Cephalaria speciosa and their potent cytotoxic and immunomodulatory activities
pmc-10560666.creator: Ozan Oztunc, Gaye Sumer Okkali, Sevda Zeinali, Ayse Nalbantsoy, Nazli Boke Sarikahya
pmc-10560666.description: Four new triterpene saponins, namely speciosides A-D (1–4) along with six known saponins were isolated from the n-butanol extract of Cephalaria speciosa. In addition to these, three new prosapogenins (2a–4a) were obtained after alkaline hydrolysis. Elucidation of the structures of the isolated compounds was carried out by 1D, 2D NMR, HR-ESI/MS and GC–MS analyses.

pmc-10655476.title: Comment on human cytomegalovirus seropositivity is associated with reduced patient survival during sepsis
pmc-10655476.creator: Hongyu Wang, Lin Zhong
pmc-10655476.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). First, the proportion of HCMV reactivation patients found in this study is much lower compared to previous studies [2–5]. The previous studies in this field included immunocompetent patients, whereas this study incorporated a significant number of immunocompromised patients. Why, in this case, does this research show a lower rate of HCMV reactivation compared to what has been reported in previous studies?

pmc-10755387.title: A scoping review of health promotion interventions delivered via social media to women of reproductive age
pmc-10755387.creator: Maddison J Henderson, Megan L Gow
pmc-10755387.description: Objective:Adult women of reproductive age are highly engaged with social media, suggesting its utility for conveying health information to this population, at scale. This scoping review aimed to describe health promotion interventions conducted via social media and assess their effectiveness to improve health outcomes, engagement and acceptability in adult women of reproductive age.Design:Six databases were searched on 13 May 2022.

pmc-11545486.title: Oxidized Low-Density Lipoprotein and Its Role in Immunometabolism
pmc-11545486.creator: Negin Mosalmanzadeh, Brandt D. Pence
pmc-11545486.description: Modified cholesterols such as oxidized low-density lipoprotein (OxLDL) contribute to atherosclerosis and other disorders through the promotion of foam cell formation and inflammation. In recent years, it has become evident that immune cell responses to inflammatory molecules such as OxLDLs depend on cellular metabolic functions.

pmc-11714419.title: Gender difference in cognitive functioning varies by level of purpose in life – Results of the New Zealand Health, Work and Retirement (NZHWR) study
pmc-11714419.creator: Susanne Röhr, Rosemary Gibson, Fiona Alpass
pmc-11714419.description: BackgroundHigh purpose in life – the extent of engagement in activities that are personally valued and give a sense of direction and meaning to life – has been associated with higher cognitive functioning and may protect against dementia. Less is known about gender differences in cognitive functioning regarding purpose in life.

pmc-12538690.title: Egg intake and cognitive function in healthy adults: A systematic review of the literature
pmc-12538690.creator: Nessmah Sultan, Nicole J. Kellow, Caroline J. Tuck, Edellyne Cheng, Clare MacMahon, Jessica R. Biesiekierski
pmc-12538690.description: BackgroundCognitive decline is a growing public health concern, particularly in aging populations. Eggs are a widely consumed, nutrient-dense food containing choline, phospholipids, tryptophan, and omega-3 fatty acids, which individually support cognitive processes such as memory, attention, and neurogenesis. While these individual nutrients have demonstrated benefits in supplementation studies, the cognitive effects of whole egg consumption are not well established.

pmc-12597190.title: Temporal trends in cross-country inequalities of neuroblastoma burden in children under 14 years of age from 1990 to 2021
pmc-12597190.creator: Siqi Zhang, Hongshuai Jia, Xiong Zhu, Guang Yue, Kaixin Peng, Pin Li, Yuandong Tao, Huixia Zhou
pmc-12597190.description: BackgroundNeuroblastoma is the most prevalent extracranial solid tumor in children. This study aims to assess the global burden of neuroblastoma in 2021.MethodsWe utilized data from the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 study to collect the incidence, prevalence, mortality, and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) of neuroblastoma, and calculated the estimated annual percentage change (EAPC).

pmc-12727865.title: Graph neural network–driven text classification for fire-door defect inspection in pre-completion construction
pmc-12727865.creator: Seunghyeon Wang
pmc-12727865.description: Defective fire doors in apartment buildings pose significant risks by undermining fire safety measures, enabling the rapid spread of smoke and fire, and potentially endangering residents’ lives. To address this critical safety issue, this research develops and evaluates four Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based text classification models—TextGCN, TextING, TensorGCN, and BERT-GCN—for the automatic identification of fire-door defects.

pmc-12784439.title: Atypical Polypoid Bladder Lesion Mimicking Urothelial Carcinoma in a Young Male: A Case Report About a Possible Autoimmune-Triggered Granulomatous Inflammation With Secondary Colonization
pmc-12784439.creator: Severin P Hofmann, Uwe Bieri, Franz von Stauffenberg, Stefan Schneider, Gad Singer, Michael Greiner, Lukas John Hefermehl
pmc-12784439.description: Gross hematuria is a critical clinical symptom requiring thorough diagnostic evaluation, particularly due to its association with urothelial carcinoma. However, other differential diagnoses must also be considered, including renal carcinoma, infection, urolithiasis, and autoimmune disease.We report the case of a 28-year-old male presenting with gross hematuria, flank pain, and dysuria.

pmc-12823583.title: Quality evaluation of Capitatae Fructus from different geographical regions in China
pmc-12823583.creator: Hairong Zhong, Qing Xia, Ying Li, Linchang Tubi, Aji Lege, Kelong Aluo, Jinsong Ren, Xiaoli Eqi
pmc-12823583.description: Capitatae Fructus (CF), an ethnomedicinal resource with both edible and medicinal values in Southwest China, has an incomplete quality evaluation system, and the regulatory mechanisms of environmental factors on its bioactive component accumulation remain unclear. In this study, 37 CF batches from 6 producing areas in Sichuan and Yunnan Provinces were analyzed.
